text:
eva_sales: Prospect (global fintech) asks for 7-year retention + legal-hold for customer-managed keys. Can Redwood act as escrow or only accept BYOK? pricing impact?

sam_sre: Short: we won't store plaintext. BYOK is supported. We can store wrapped blobs (opaque ciphertext) but ops/compliance required. Dedicated/Private can get SLA for unwrap routing; hosted depends on customer's KMS uptime.

lin_eng: Tech note: wrapped-backup = customer supplies ciphertext blob, we store it encrypted at rest and never decrypt. Need agreed format (AWS KMS blob vs PKCS#7), sample blob, QPS, rotation cadence.

tara_legal: Legal: OK to store wrapped blobs only. If Redwood acts as escrowee, require retrieval workflow, limited-use clause, indemnity for compelled disclosure, and explicit prohibition on storing or accessing plaintext.

eva_sales: Customer will push for Redwood to be escrowee and asks for a price range now. Can we give a ballpark?

nina_prod: Product: ship as "Managed wrapped key backup" enterprise add-on. Pricing idea: onboarding fee + annual compliance surcharge + storage + per-retrieval fee. Put "custom quote" in SOW until compliance sign-off.

sam_sre: Ops checklist: HSM-enveloped storage, strict RBAC (no one can decrypt), immutable audit logs, multi-approver retrieval, retention lifecycle, and retrieval drills. SLA must carve out customer KMS downtime.

compliance_bot: reminder: run `/new-compliance-review managed-wrapped-backup <prospect> <scope:retention+retrieval>` before quoting.

eva_sales: Next steps I'll send the customer a short reply: we don't store plaintext; we can offer wrapped-only managed backup as add-on (custom quote, requires compliance review); Dedicated/Private for SLA-backed unwrap routing; ask for KMS vendor, endpoints, QPS, rotation cadence, and a sample wrapped blob. Scheduling scoping call now.
